property_summary: A successful play() call with exactly 10 wei always resets the pot to zero only when the contract actually pays out, and the pot afterwards is exactly the pot before the call plus 10 minus any payout; equivalently, if no payout occurs then potAfter == potBefore + 10, and if a payout occurs then potAfter == 0 and potBefore + 10 == potAfter + 10.
